text: Gaheris of Orkney was an Arthurian hero. He was a son of King Lot of Orkney and Morgause. Morgause was the half-sister of King Arthur. She also bore Mordred, Arthur's illegitimate son and tireless enemy. Lancelot killed Gaheris while rescuing Queen Guinevere from death by burning. Gaheris was one of the knights who died in that rescue.

okr.objective: Record Gaheris of Orkney as an Arthurian hero and son of Lot and Morgause.
key_results: Name Gaheris as a son of Lot and Morgause.
